# Canva: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Review window: 16 October to 15 November 2026. Unverified items are marked **[unverified]**.*

## Executive Summary

Canva's largest change in the window is a workforce restructuring. CEO Melanie Perkins described it as "our hardest year yet," after growth slowed "for the first time in a decade" ([BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). No verified product launches, executive hires, or new deals fall inside the 30-day window in the material reviewed.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News: Restructuring

| Item | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | 1,271 people (about 22% of staff) affected through job loss, role change, or relocation | [Silicon Republic, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life) |
| Organisation | Product, Growth and Platform merging into one organisation | [LinkedIn, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Location | Sydney to become the "primary home" for more product teams; hybrid staff expected in the office 2–3 days a week from next year | [BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |
| Timeline | Memo issued 3 November; company-wide meeting 10 November; reorganised units meet from 11 November | [Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Severance | Reported: six months' salary, 12 months' healthcare, $10,000 support, career assistance, laptop retention. One commentator's post and one practitioner article report these; the 26-week figure is from Niehues | [LinkedIn, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140); [Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026) |
| Exit count | Canva has not disclosed how many will leave | [Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Further cuts | Reported possible second round or hiring freeze in November **[unverified]** | [PeopleMatters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |

### Financial Context (Mostly Before the Window, Newly Reported)

- The 2026 growth forecast was cut from 30% to 20%, which The Information attributed to heavy AI use driving up costs ([The Information, 2026](https://x.com/theinformation/status/2086158004525699220)).
- Reported Q2 2026 revenue was $921.9 million, up 25.2% year over year, which missed internal guidance ([The SaaS CFO, 2026](https://www.thesaascfo.com/ai-cogs-earnings-risk)).
- Perkins reportedly wrote that Canva had been "relying too heavily on frontier models" ([The SaaS CFO, 2026](https://www.thesaascfo.com/ai-cogs-earnings-risk)).
- Valuation reportedly fell from A$60bn to about A$49bn ([BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).
- **Source conflict:** Prior-year revenue is reported as $3.5 billion ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)), about $3 billion GAAP ([ORM News, 2026](https://orm-tech.com/news/20260813-canva-cuts-2026-growth-forecast-by-a-third-on-ai-costs)), and about $4 billion ARR ([The SaaS CFO, 2026](https://www.thesaascfo.com/ai-cogs-earnings-risk)). Canva is private, so treat these figures as unverified.

### Product Launches

No launch dated within the window was verified. Recent items, all outside it:

| Launch | Date | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Canva Grow 2.0 (ad creation and performance loop) | 24 June 2026 | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva) |
| Magic Layers in Gemini and ChatGPT | 7 June 2026 | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva) |
| Learn Grid (free education platform) | 11 May 2026 | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva) |
| Canva AI 2.0 ("biggest product launch in our history") | Date not verified **[unverified]** | [Canva Newsroom, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-create-2026-ai) |
| Creative Operating System | Date not verified **[unverified]** | [Canva Newsroom, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/creative-operating-system) |

### Executive and Key Hires

No executive appointments or key hires were found in the material. Perkins remains CEO and is the named spokesperson for the restructuring ([BBC, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). An opt-in alumni directory has been set up for departing staff ([LinkedIn, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)).

### Deals and Partnerships

No deals were dated within the window. Ongoing partnerships include Canva as a design partner across Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot and Gemini ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva)), plus integrations with HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo and Meta's catalogue ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/canva)). Their exact dates are not verified.

## Analysis

In my view, the restructuring is primarily a response to growth and cost pressure, not a direct AI-substitution story. Canva's stated rationale is slowing growth and the need to move faster, and the cost pressure comes from AI inference, not from replacing staff ([Amazing Workplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)). Merging Product, Growth and Platform targets the handoff delays that the company's own reporting implies slowed its launches ([Niehues Consulting, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

The main execution risk is timing. The reorganisation coincides with a major AI product push and an active cost-reduction programme, and reports of further cuts or a hiring freeze suggest the structure is not yet settled. Source quality is mixed: the BBC, Silicon Republic and The Information are the most reliable. The LinkedIn items and the SaaS CFO's secondary citations of Canva's letter should be used with caution.

## Open Questions for Canva

1. Of the 1,271 people affected, what is the split between exits, role changes and relocations, and is the reported November hiring freeze or second round of cuts planned?
2. What AI unit-cost targets has Canva set, and how do they feed into the revised 20% growth forecast?
3. How will decision rights work in the merged Product organisation, particularly for Grow 2.0 and other launches that depended on Growth-to-Product handoffs?

## References

- Canva Newsroom. (2026). *Introducing Canva AI 2.0*. [https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-create-2026-ai](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-create-2026-ai)
- Canva Newsroom. (2026). *Introducing Canva's Creative Operating System*. [https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/creative-operating-system](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/creative-operating-system)
- LinkedIn. (2026). *Canva announces restructuring affecting over 1,200 jobs*. [https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)
- Niehues Consulting. (2026, November 9). *Canva layoffs 2026: The restructuring targets handovers*. [https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)
- ORM News. (2026, August 13). *Canva cuts 2026 growth forecast by a third on AI costs*. [https://orm-tech.com/news/20260813-canva-cuts-2026-growth-forecast-by-a-third-on-ai-costs](https://orm-tech.com/news/20260813-canva-cuts-2026-growth-forecast-by-a-third-on-ai-costs)
- PeopleMatters. (2026, November 3). *Canva layoffs in November? Company reportedly weighs job cuts or hiring freeze*. [https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)

Chris G | VC + Startups on Instagram: "Canva’s 2026 layoffs have a plot twist: the company is helping its former employees become entrepreneurs.

Imagine getting laid off and your employer offers to help fund your next startup. That’s essentially what Canva is doing.

CEO Melanie Perkins announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, or 22% of the workforce. Not all are being laid off; some face role changes or relocation.

But look at the exit package:

→ At least 6 months of salary
→ 12 months of healthcare where available
→ Employees keep their MacBooks
→ $10,000 startup grants through the Canva Collective Fund, with no equity taken
→ Career coaching and LinkedIn Premium

Now here’s what investors should actually pay attention to.

Canva lowered its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% as AI costs put pressure on its business model.

Meanwhile, Product, Growth, and Platform are being consolidated into one organization.

Translation: AI isn’t just changing what software companies sell. It’s changing the cost of delivering their products and how teams need to operate.

And here’s the overlooked opportunity: Canva’s departing talent could become the next generation of startup founders.

Losing your job is never easy. But giving employees financial runway, healthcare, and a chance to build something new is a much better exit than simply handing them a severance check.

The lesson for founders? How you treat employees on the way out says a lot about how you build a company.

Would you rather have six months of severance or a shot at funding your own startup?
